policy: Public pages must not render the retired low-quality educational diagram/infographic families. The rule applies whether an image is a current WordPress media attachment, an orphaned uploads URL, or a hardcoded source URL. All legacy Teaching Healthy Cultivation educational-image identities are quarantined unless a replacement carries DTF_APPROVED_PUBLIC_VISUAL. Retired files may remain in source control only as historical/archive material; they must not render on dtfseeds.com.

notes: This quarantine intentionally mirrors site/wordpress/visual-quality-policy.json: the legacy Teaching Healthy Cultivation infographic identity is not valid public artwork.
The C###, ENC-### and Outdoor-## educational image families are retired from all visitor-facing surfaces, regardless of whether WordPress still indexes the upload as media.
Do not weaken a retirement rule merely to make a publisher pass. Replace the visual with an explicitly approved production asset instead.
The render-layer CSS blocks a stale forbidden visual immediately; the content guard then removes its markup and matched WordPress media identity.
Image-less cards are the required fallback when no approved role-specific replacement exists.
